programs.program: Pathways to Enable Secure Open-Source Ecosystems (PESOSE), NSF 26-506
programs.application_state_basis: The official solicitation page was labeled active/current and listed the next deadline as 2026-09-01.

deadline.timezone_basis: submitting organization's local time; not a UTC instant

programs.program_eligibility_text: Program text names U.S. institutions of higher education; qualifying U.S. nonprofit, nonacademic research or education organizations; qualifying U.S.-based for-profit organizations including small businesses; state and local governments; Tribal Nations; and specified federal or FFRDC cases. Non-IHE PI and ownership or control restrictions also apply.
programs.funding_text: Track 1 maximum USD 300,000; Track 2 maximum USD 1,500,000; Track 3 maximum USD 1,500,000; all subject to availability.
programs.matching_basis: The solicitation prohibits voluntary committed cost sharing.
programs.ip_terms: UNKNOWN: IP ownership terms were not established from the inspected solicitation.
deliverables: For Track 1 or Track 2, I-Corps for PESOSE participation unless the solicitation's stated waiver condition applies.
programs.fit_note: ANALYSIS: Existing public Commons artifacts may map to open-source ecosystem work, but that observation is neither applicant eligibility nor program fit adjudication.
programs.public_next_action: Compare already-public Commons artifacts with the Track 1, Track 2, and Track 3 required sections and the collaboration-letter requirement.
